Francisco presented *Producing Population-level Estimates of Internal Displacement in Ukraine Using GPS Mobile Phone Data* at the International Population Conference (IPC2025), held in Brisbane, Australia, on 16 July 2025.

This talk presented methods to produce population-level estimates of internal displacement in Ukraine using GPS mobile phone data, with emphasis on near real-time measurement and population inference.

The presentation focused on how high-frequency mobile phone location data can be used to generate timely and policy-relevant population estimates during crises. It highlighted the potential of digital trace data to support the measurement of displacement dynamics while maintaining attention to robust inference and methodological challenges.
